response.query: Which candidate instruments will we pre-specify, what is the exclusion-restriction argument for each, and which weak-instrument and overidentification diagnostics will we run?
response.answer: We will pre-specify candidate instruments based on prior studies; exclusion-restriction argues they affect outcomes only through the intended variable; we will run weak-instrument tests and overidentification checks.
